# Skill Documentation

End-user-facing documentation for fixture skills. Defaults are documented in [configuration](./configuration.md).

---

## The loop

```text
/ce-alpha -> /ce-beta -> /ce-gamma
```

This section has no table and must not become a group.

---

## Group One

Two skills that run in order.

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| [`/ce-alpha`](./ce-alpha.md) | First step: define what to build |
| [`/ce-beta`](./ce-beta.md) | Second step with `code` and *emphasis* |

---

## Group Two

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| [`/ce-gamma`](./ce-gamma.md) | Turn a [Riffrec](https://github.com/kieranklaassen/riffrec) recording into feedback |
